title: Everyone's in it. The dog counts.
text: Every friend becomes a fighter with a type, stats and signature moves. Nala is in as herself, same face, same tongue. Pick how many of you there are; the photos can come last.

title: Kart races, a brawler, a gym you build your way up
text: Big games are the set pieces a chapter is built around. Kai's gym is a timber yard you climb with ramps you build yourself. And every mate you meet can deal you in to one of twelve party games, from blackjack to a pour-stopping test of nerve.

label: MAP
title: Your town becomes the map
text: The flat, the beach, the bar you always end up in, laid out from your own photos. You are standing {place} right now.

title: Pull up in style
text: Buy a car at the dealership and drive it round town, rent a scooter on the phone, hail a taxi between your places, or ride a mine cart. Walking works too, if you're into that.

title: It rings. It's usually trouble.
text: Everyone carries a phone in the game. Calls kick off the quest, breaking news lands mid-adventure, and the Photos app holds your real photos, redrawn.

label: STORY
title: The night everyone still talks about
text: Lost passports, a missed flight, a stag do gone sideways. You tell us the story and it becomes the main quest. You are walking as Rico, and his passport goes missing first.

title: The thing he always does is now an attack
text: Tell us what everyone always does. Elias got a mic and a move called Siren Song. Your mate might get a golf swing, a camera flash, an evolution, or a voice line in their own voice.
